name: sous-monorepo
//overrides: react/react-dom/scheduler are pinned so the entire dependency tree — including transitive peer auto-installs — collapses to a single version. React Native 0.86.3 (Expo SDK 57) supports React 19.2.x and ships scheduler 0.27.0, so bump these pins only alongside @sous/mobile's expo/react-native versions.
//security-overrides: csstype/js-yaml/postcss/form-data/ws/uuid are forced to patched versions to clear known advisories without the breaking major bumps `npm audit fix --force` would apply. js-yaml 4.2.0 clears the react-native/expo cascade (load-nyc-config only uses .load(), present in v4); ws 8.21.0 clears the viem/clerk chain plus metro dev tooling; the rest are straightforward patch bumps. The metro/metro-config/metro-transform-worker pins to 0.84.5 ARE security fixes: every published image-size is vulnerable (GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr, GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq), and the advisory covers metro 0.22.1-0.83.7, 0.84.0-0.84.4 and >=0.85.0 — so 0.84.5 is the one safe release, and it is what Expo SDK 57 resolves to anyway. Verify `npm audit` still reports 0 after any metro change.
//expo-sdk-pins: The expo/expo-*/react-native/react-native-* pins are NOT security fixes: they hold the tree on the Expo SDK 57 line. Several SDK packages declare loose peer ranges (expo:*, @expo/metro-config:>=54, expo-font:>=14), so without these pins a re-resolve leaves two or three SDK lines installed side by side — during the 55->57 upgrade the tree briefly carried expo 55, 56 and 57 plus three @expo/metro-config copies at once. To move SDK: delete these pins, run `npx expo install expo@^NN --fix` in apps/mobile, read the new targets out of node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json, re-add the pins at those versions, then `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install`. The clean re-resolve is required — incremental installs leave duplicate native modules behind. Finish with `npx expo-doctor` (expect 21/21) and `npx expo export -p ios`.
